content: आशुशुक्षणि {%a.%} [आ शष् सन् अनि <ls>Uṇ. 2. 102</ls>] .²1 Being worshipped on account of shining very quickly, or causing sorrow to oneʼs enemies (<ls>Sāy.</ls>). .²2 Shining forth. .{@-णिः@} .²1 Wind, air. .²2 Fire; <ls>Bhāg. 8. 19. 26</ls>; मन्त्रपूतानि हवींषि प्रतिगृह्णात्येतत् प्रीत्याशुशुक्षणिः <ls>K. 44</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Bhāg. 8. 19. 26</ls>.
